nodes.plm_action: Wash the pot or saucepan with soap and water.
nodes.plm_caption:
A woman is shown cooking food on a stove and then moves to the kitchen to wash the pot. The woman is wearing a black shirt and has a scarf around her head.
The stove has a kettle on it and there is a pot on the stove. She pours ingredients into a bowl then scoops the contents into the pot. The person then washes the contents of the pot by hand under the tap, adding soap, and rinses them off under the tap.

summary.brief: A woman cooks a brown stew in a pot and then cleans the burnt pot until it shines.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a silver pot on the stove containing a bubbling brown liquid and pieces of meat, which the woman in a black shirt and scarf stirs with a red spatula. After the cooking segment, she carries the pot to the kitchen sink, adds water and a few drops of dish‑soap together with an old dryer sheet, lets it sit, then scrubs the interior with a sponge (later a light‑blue brush) in circular motions, tilting the pot to reach all surfaces. She rinses away the suds under running water, dries the pot with a blue cloth, and holds it up to show the interior clean and gleaming.

action.detailed: Scrub the pot with a sponge or brush, rinse it under running water, and dry it with a cloth until it shines.
action.actor: a woman wearing a black shirt and a scarf
